en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a street scene in a small town or village. The main focus is a half-timbered building with the inscription 'Bergeshöhe' and 'Max Kolfert' on its facade, likely a shop or guesthouse. Next to it is another building with signs, trees, and a signpost. The postcard text at the top reads 'Oberbärenburg — Ost-Erzgebirge ca. 750 m ü. N. N.' indicating the location and altitude.
